query: When are winter tires required in Quebec (Canada)?
llm-response:
In Quebec, Canada, the use of winter tires is mandatory for all vehicles from December 1st to March 15th, inclusive. This regulation applies to all drivers, regardless of the type of vehicle they own or the region they live in within the province.

The purpose of this law is to enhance road safety during the winter season, when snow and ice can make driving conditions challenging. Winter tires provide better traction and handling on snowy and icy roads compared to all-season or summer tires, reducing the risk of accidents.

It is important for drivers in Quebec to plan ahead and have their vehicles equipped with appropriate winter tires before the start of the mandatory period. Failure to comply with the winter tire regulation can result in fines and penalties.
